mixing: Material effects at -5 dB recommended under bed.wav (-3 dB). Keep rhythmic player melody audible. Use one material impact per strike, with optional thump only for a large smash. Avoid stacking all material effects for every fragment.

descriptions.wood: Dry board split: low hollow knock and irregular cracks.
descriptions.glass: Clear small glass shard cascade with restrained high frequencies.
descriptions.metal: Dense metal clang with short inharmonic ringing.
descriptions.thump: Heavy close impact with audible low-mid punch, no long sub tail.
descriptions.slap: Cartoony palm slap: crisp dry clap with a warm short pop, no long hiss.
